retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style flat-lay illustration featuring hand-drawn stationery items with ink outlines and watercolor washes, framed by a desk blotter and topped with heavy slab-serif display type.
triggerTerms: retro slab serif album cover style
excludeWhen: modern minimalist vector art is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A top-down, slightly angled illustration of a green desk blotter with brown leather corners, scattered with white and yellow envelopes, lined paper, a fountain pen, a pencil, and a blue inkwell. The style uses thin, slightly irregular black ink outlines filled with textured, non-uniform color washes. The composition is framed by a cream-colored border containing bold, typewriter-inspired slab serif text at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Central cluster of white and yellow stationery against a vibrant green background
Writing tools (pen, pencil, inkwell) anchored at the bottom of the frame
Heavy black typography contrasting with the light cream outer border
Hand-drawn line work providing a tactile, human quality to geometric shapes
coreInvariants: Thin black ink outlines for all objects
Visible watercolor or screen-print texture in color fills
Cream-colored outer margin framing the central green blotter
Slab serif typography with distinct typewriter-like slab feet

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The stationery cluster occupies the upper-middle center; writing tools are scaled smaller at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The green desk blotter acts as the primary stage for all illustrated elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large display text at the top, move down through the pile of letters, and settle on the inkwell and pen at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous cream-colored margins around the central green rectangle create a clean, framed look.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cobalt blue (inkwell), Mustard yellow (lined paper), and Pink (envelope lining)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for the green and blue, contrasted against low-saturation cream and white.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to a primary-adjacent palette with vintage desaturation

letterConstructionRules: Slightly irregular spacing mimicking manual typesetting
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters have prominent, flat horizontal serifs
Lowercase 'e' has a horizontal crossbar and wide curve
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large bold slab serif for title paired with a smaller, lighter version for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the typewriter slab aesthetic with modern clarity.
Provides the heavy, geometric slab serifs seen in the display text.
Matches the mid-century editorial feel of the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a hand-drawn illustration of a green desk blotter with brown leather corners on a cream background. On the blotter, include a messy pile of white and yellow envelopes, a piece of blue-lined paper, a fountain pen, a pencil, and a blue glass inkwell. Use thin black ink outlines and watercolor-style color fills with visible paper texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of large, bold slab-serif text in black at the top center of the cream border. Add one line of small, light slab-serif metadata text at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Does the text use a slab-serif font?
Is there a cream-colored border around the green blotter?
Are the objects outlined in thin black ink?
Is the color application textured like watercolor or screen print?

mustRedesign: Specific logo in the top left corner
Artist signature in the bottom right of the illustration
Exact catalog number at the bottom
postGenerationChecks: Check that the green blotter has brown corner accents.
Ensure the typography is centered and uses slab serifs.
Verify the presence of a fountain pen and inkwell.
Confirm the background has a subtle paper-like texture.
